active_finding.summary: V5 is content-dependent but still feels primarily like retrieving explicit facts and selecting matching clauses; it does not yet provide enough ARG-like investigation, layered inference, lore significance, or relevance to the larger story.
active_finding.brad_question: Will all campaign puzzles feel this way?
active_finding.brad_direction: The campaign must not reduce its investigations to clause retrieval.
active_finding.current_evidentiary_status: V5 may remain a technical proof but is not sufficient experiential proof without Brad approval.

p4_must_require: an emotionally and lore-relevant synthesis establishing why the rational refuge matters
phase_2_interpretation.current_v5_concern: Explicit fact recovery plus a matching-clause ledger does not yet demonstrate the authorized experiential depth.

campaign_variety_rule.requirement: Use and combine modalities according to each arc's authored grammar; do not make every arc a matching-clause retrieval exercise.

binding_progression_correction.rule: A correct answer or conclusion must be accepted even when the submitting player and the shared campaign state have zero observed-source interaction receipts.
acceptance_semantics: correct externally known or player-shared answers pass
wrong answers still fail exact predicates
one player may share a deduction without every participant touching its sources
observation custody remains durable but cannot veto a correct answer
binding_progression_correction.supersedes: V4 and V5 P4 source-possession gating, including rejection of a correct conclusion because surviving records remain unentered
binding_progression_correction.all_substantial_content_reconciliation: Substantial content is materially necessary for fair deduction, synthesis, callbacks, and later understanding; it is not enforced through click-completion quotas.
required_future_negative_tests: a correct four-finding report succeeds with zero observation receipts
a correct synthesis succeeds after that zero-observation correct report
a wrong report with zero or many observation receipts still fails
observation provenance, contribution custody, replay, and catch-up remain intact and non-gating
binding_progression_correction.implementation_hold: Do not change the live V5 runtime or implement this supersession until Brad finishes the review and disconnects.

binding_cross_media_and_geometry_correct.minecraft_boundary: Do not hardcode P4 around literal cart-path tracing, block-by-block archaeology, or fragile mandatory bespoke-block geometry.
binding_cross_media_and_geometry_correct.cross_media_identity: Minecraft is one evidence surface among website/community, remembered NPC dialogue, callbacks, footage/video, files, images, audio, metadata, recovered documents, and social activity.
binding_cross_media_and_geometry_correct.lore_direction: Evidence must be consequential, spooky, uncanny, human, emotionally relevant, and connected to the central mystery; administrative matching may be texture or one layer but may not dominate.
binding_cross_media_and_geometry_correct.approved_reference: Mara/library coordinates such as 3-1-4 / 2-1-5 / 6-3-1 may establish a discoverable shelf-line-word or related indexing grammar; other mechanisms must be distinct and grounded.
binding_cross_media_and_geometry_correct.receipt_honesty: Separate offline-authored authorities, clue graphs, test fixtures, and specifications from unavailable external media, hosting, community, social, and player receipts.
binding_cross_media_and_geometry_correct.implementation_hold: Record and plan now; do not mutate or stop the live V5 server and do not implement before explicit disconnect.

binding_dramaturgy_and_creative_variatio.rule: Brad's mechanism families are examples only, never an allowlist, enum, quota, fixed catalog, or hardcoded runtime puzzle type. Author from revelation and emotional reversal outward using generic composable primitives.
binding_dramaturgy_and_creative_variatio.mined_precedent: Preserve Iss/Liar correct-decode/wrong-interpretation and cold reread, delayed callbacks, situated professional grammars, multiple in-doors, contradiction/provenance, acknowledged true-but-not-door findings, quiet lore, changing meanings, asymmetric theory, judgment, and aftermath while rejecting stale implementations.
binding_dramaturgy_and_creative_variatio.p4_reversal: apparent occult/cult ruin -> ordinary refuge life -> disturbing origin of Ways/Record as practical procedure becomes institutional control under early anomalous pressure; earn only C02 and do not reduce the conclusion to capacity/route matching
binding_dramaturgy_and_creative_variatio.implementation_hold: No live-world implementation, mutation, or stop before Brad explicitly disconnects.

binding_copperline_expansion.rule: Copperline becomes a recurring believable hosting/community archive with human history, ordinary texture, distinct voices, immutable provenance, callbacks, responsive/accessibility behavior, and honest future deployment receipts.
binding_copperline_expansion.c01_boundary: mkept was a real person who deliberately preserved a damaged server; no later-case truth or locked ambiguity resolves early
binding_copperline_expansion.implementation_hold: Do not mutate or stop live V5 before explicit disconnect.
